subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context: a single academic school spanning sport and exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength and conditioning. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so this pack is grounded in sport and exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark record.
